theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_st_div_product
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (x : Euclid (m + 1)), DifferentiableAt ℝ v x → DifferentiableAt ℝ G x → v x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G x) = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * G y i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) - fderiv ℝ v x (G x)
